source.title: Lost Heirloom
source.description:
I came to Stormwind as a refugee, fleeing the devastation brought to Lordaeron by the Scourge. I thank the Light that my family and I escaped, but some of our treasured heirlooms still remain in the Plaguelands.

If you are able to retrieve these heirlooms from their resting place in Sorrow Hill Crypt so I may safely inter them in the Cathedral's catacombs, I would be in your debt.
source.objective: Retrieve the heirlooms from Sorrow Hill Crypt in Western Plaguelands, then return to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind Cathedral.
source.progress: Have you returned from the Plaguelands?
source.completion: Thank you, <name>. You say you found a journal?
